sanskrit_verse:
वैवाह्य श्रोत्रियैर् भुक्तं राज्ञामात्यैस् तथैव च /
सुदीर्घेणापि कालेन तेषां सिद्ध्यति तन् न तु //
transliteration: vaivāhya śrotriyair bhuktaṃ rājñāmātyais tathaiva ca / sudīrghenāpi kālena teṣāṃ sidhyati tan na tu //
sph_interpretive_translation: That which has been enjoyed by learned Brahmanas in marriage, or consumed by kings and ministers — even if time passes greatly, it does not succeed for them, nor does it bear fruit.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Dharma, not from position alone
Consumption or enjoyment without lawful capacity creates no entitlement
Causation is rooted in consciousness alignment, not temporal duration
Restoration requires acknowledgment of misaligned possession or enjoyment
Consciousness misalignment nullifies any claim regardless of time
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity consumes or enjoys a resource without dharmic capacity THEN no ownership or benefit accrues regardless of duration
IF a ruler or minister acts without alignment with Śrotriya guidance THEN all fruits of such action are void
IF time elapses without conscious alignment THEN no legal validity is conferred
IF an act originates from misaligned authority THEN restoration must precede reintegration
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, any decree or benefit derived from misaligned authority — whether royal, ministerial, or ritual — remains invalid regardless of duration. The court must restore original dharmic alignment prior to recognizing any claim.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misaligned consumption or governance cannot be validated by time. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that misalignment perpetuates dissonance rather than legitimacy. Responsibility lies in re-establishing alignment, not in punitive correction. Truth restores automatically when alignment is recovered.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Return all benefits acquired under misaligned authority to original dharmic source
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Ruler/minister acknowledges misalignment and surrenders false claims
Capacity Restoration: Re-establish Śrotriya counsel as foundational authority
Integrity Reintegration: Public ceremonial affirmation of corrected alignment
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: misaligned enjoyment bears no fruit, time does not legitimize falsehood, and only consciousness-aligned authority restores Dharma. Thus is justice non-punitive, reality intact, and Dharma re-established.
